messages:
deploybot: Starting migration add_user_ttl_backfill v2 -> rolling apply on shard-group-3. backfill workers=8, rate_cap=120rps. kickoff at 09:12 UTC
carla: seeing small lease jitter on deploybot leases in metrics, can we hold the backfill start? :eyes:
ben: +1 hold. last time jitter caused duplicate worker runs and PK conflicts on users__shadow table
deepa: ops-alerts just fired a noisy-alert for deploybot lease-renew failures, 503s spiking to 6% in us-east-1
ops-alerts: ALERT: deploybot lease_renew_error rate > threshold for 3m. affected service: backfill-worker. link: https://ops.example/alerts/9876 :alarm_clock:
dinesh: on it, pausing the backfill via rollout policy. running: `redwood rollout pause --deployment backfill/add_user_ttl_backfill`
carla: thanks. also pin api service to v1.14.3 for the window to avoid new lease behavior. `kubectl annotate deploy/api version-pin=1.14.3`
ben: note: don't rollback schema yet — only pause workers. we need to avoid partial TTL set leaving users in mixed state. plan: pause -> validate prefix cache -> resume with workers=2 and rate_cap=40rps
deepa: extracting recent logs for the backfill workers, small snippet:
```
2026-03-21T09:11:43Z backfill-worker-3 ERR lease renew failed: rpc timeout
2026-03-21T09:11:44Z backfill-worker-5 WARN duplicate job detected for shard 7
2026-03-21T09:11:46Z coordinator INFO pausing job queue for add_user_ttl_backfill
```
carla: thanks. my worry: if we resume without pinning the migration runner image, we may reintroduce the jitter. ops, can you confirm image digest for backfill-runner?
ops-alerts: current image: gcr.io/redwood/backfill-runner@sha256:abcd1234 (deployed 2026-03-21T08:50)
dinesh: I'll keep paused and open a canary: resume for shard 0 only, workers=1, rate_cap=10rps. if no lease errors in 5m we slowly scale to 2 then 4
ben: also add a temporary feature-flag to gate the backfill consumer. escape hatch: `ff:backfill_consumer=false` in toggle-service for org:all
carla: agree. Deepa, can you run the quick consistency check against sample keys after canary shard finishes? SQL to run example:
```
SELECT id FROM users WHERE ttl IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100;
```
deepa: will do. starting canary once dinesh confirms. also creating a release-note entry: "Paused add_user_ttl_backfill due to deploybot lease jitter; canary resumed for shard 0. No rollback to schema planned."
deploybot: Rollout paused by dinesh at 2026-03-21T09:12:10Z. awaiting operator resume. :white_check_mark:
ben: thread for post-mortem and followups: capture root cause of lease jitter, consider exponential backoff on lease_renew RPCs and add deploybot metrics digest. filing a ticket: ENG-5678
carla: ack. leave this thread pinned to the release channel and update release-notes/CHANGELOG with the holdpoint. :thumbsup:
